title: Understanding Feature Selection
text: Feature selection involves choosing the most relevant features for your model. This helps in reducing overfitting and improving model interpretability.

title: Regularization Techniques
text: Regularization techniques like L1 and L2 are used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the loss function. L1 regularization can lead to sparse solutions, effectively selecting features.

title: L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. It can shrink some coefficients to zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.
